title: Fewer repeated grammar statements
description: Parsimony is the axis that favors fewer or less-duplicated grammar statements while preserving known valid readings. It is distinct from restrictiveness, which asks how narrowly a statement licenses forms.

# Parsimony

Parsimony favors fewer or less-duplicated grammar statements while preserving known valid readings. It is one of the two axes in a [Parsimony review](term:parsimony-review), alongside [restrictiveness](term:restrictiveness).
